- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recommendations for watercolor paints: 
  - Winsor & Newton Cotman Watercolors: A beginner's set with 12 vibrant colors.
  - Daniel Smith Watercolors: Higher-end brand known for exceptional lightfastness and pigment load.
  - Holbein Watercolors: Japanese brand with unique pigments and excellent lightfastness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recommendations for watercolor brushes:
  - Winsor & Newton Cotman Brushes: Affordable and come in various sizes and shapes.
  - Escoda Brushes: Spanish brand known for high-quality, synthetic brushes.
  - Da Vinci Watercolor Brushes: High-end, handmade brushes made from natural and synthetic fibers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered additional tips for watercolor painting, including using high-quality water and suitable surfaces, experimenting with brushstrokes, and mixing paints.
